summary: a wardley link or evolve names an undeclared component
help: Declare the component, or fix the spelling.
rationale: Mermaid drops the statement silently, so the map shows fewer links than the source declares.

summary: wardley component is not referenced by any link, evolve, or pipeline
help: Connect the component, or remove it.
rationale: An unreferenced component renders as an isolated dot, which is sometimes intended, so this rule is off by default.

summary: wardley map declares no components or anchors
help: Add at least one component or anchor line.
rationale: The map parses, but it renders empty.

help: Write every coordinate on one scale.
rationale: Mermaid reads each value independently, so a coordinate on the wrong scale places the component far from where the author meant.

summary: the same component or anchor name is declared more than once
rationale: Mermaid merges the declarations and the last coordinates win, so the earlier ones are silently lost.
